series.en_title: Riemannian Optimization from the Ground Up
series.bilibili_title: 【从零开始的黎曼优化】拓扑→流形→反函数定理→切空间→黎曼梯度｜完整证明+反例动画｜中英字幕（6P）
series.zh_intro:
为什么要在球面、旋转群这样的弯曲空间上做优化？要做梯度下降，需要先回答：什么是流形、怎样不画坐标卡就证明方程的解集是流形、在一点能往哪些方向走、哪个方向下降最快、走一步之后怎样留在流形上。
这套系列从拓扑讲起，一路推到黎曼梯度与 retraction。每个定理都给出动机、完整证明，并用动画反例说明每个条件为什么不能去掉——很多结论看起来"显然"，只有看到条件失效会怎样坏，才真正明白它的意义。
series.en_intro:
Why optimize on curved spaces such as spheres or rotation groups? Gradient descent there first needs answers to: what a manifold is, how to prove that the solution set of equations is a manifold without drawing charts, which directions are available at a point, which one decreases fastest, and how to take a step and stay on the manifold.
This series starts from topology and builds up to the Riemannian gradient and retractions. Every theorem comes with its motivation, a complete proof, and animated counterexamples showing why each hypothesis is needed.

episodes.zh_summary: 为什么弯曲空间上的优化需要新的语言？本集从度量与开球出发建立拓扑：开集公理、收敛、连续（并证明与 ε-δ 定义等价）、同胚。反例说明：为什么只允许有限交、为什么连续性用原像而不是像、为什么同胚必须要求逆映射连续。
episodes.en_summary: Why does optimization on curved spaces need a new language? Starting from metrics and open balls, this episode builds topology: the open-set axioms, convergence, continuity (with a full proof that it agrees with ε–δ), and homeomorphisms. Counterexamples show why only finite intersections are allowed, why continuity uses preimages, and why a homeomorphism needs a continuous inverse.

episodes.zh: 坐标卡、图册与光滑流形
episodes.zh_summary: 流形是"局部像 ℝⁿ"的空间。本集讲坐标卡与拓扑流形（用双原点直线说明 Hausdorff 条件为何必要），转移映射与光滑相容性（用 x³ 坐标卡说明不相容会让"光滑"产生歧义），证明光滑映射的定义与坐标卡选取无关，并讨论微分同胚、内蕴与外蕴两种视角。
episodes.en_summary: A manifold is a space that locally looks like ℝⁿ. This episode covers charts and topological manifolds (the line with two origins shows why Hausdorff matters), transition maps and smooth compatibility (an x³ chart shows how incompatible charts make 'smooth' ambiguous), a proof that smoothness of maps does not depend on the chosen charts, diffeomorphisms, and the intrinsic versus extrinsic views.

episodes.zh_summary: 反函数定理是"由方程制造坐标卡"的引擎。本集讲导数作为最佳线性近似、压缩映射原理及其证明，并完整走一遍 Rudin 9.24 的证明：局部单射、像为开集、逆映射可微。四个反例——x³、x² 的折叠、极坐标映射、x + 2x² sin(1/x)——说明每个条件为什么不可少。
episodes.en_summary: The inverse function theorem is the engine that turns equations into charts. This episode covers the derivative as the best linear approximation, the contraction mapping principle with its proof, and the complete proof of Rudin 9.24: local injectivity, openness of the image, differentiability of the inverse. Four counterexamples — x³, the fold x², the polar map, and x + 2x² sin(1/x) — show why each hypothesis is needed.

episodes.zh: 隐函数定理与正则水平集
episodes.zh_summary: 怎样不画坐标卡就证明方程的解集是流形？本集由反函数定理推出隐函数定理（完整证明），给出正则值与正则水平集定理的证明，以球面为例一次求导得到流形结构；再用交叉点、尖点和 (xᵀx−1)² 说明正则性为何必要，以及定理只给出充分条件。
episodes.en_summary: How do we prove that the solution set of equations is a manifold without drawing a single chart? This episode derives the implicit function theorem from the inverse function theorem (full proof), proves the regular level-set theorem, gets the sphere's manifold structure from one derivative, and uses a crossing, a cusp and (xᵀx−1)² to show why regularity matters and why the theorem is only sufficient.

episodes.zh_summary: 优化器需要知道在一点能往哪些方向走。本集用曲线速度定义切向量，证明正则水平集的切空间 TₚM = ker Dh(p)（含秩–零化度定理的证明）；再完整推导正交群 O(n)：微分、满射性、维数 n(n−1)/2、切空间 R·Skew(n)，以及 SO(3) 的三个旋转自由度，并说明为什么陪域必须取对称矩阵空间。
episodes.en_summary: An optimizer needs to know which directions are available at a point. This episode defines tangent vectors as velocities of curves, proves T_pM = ker Dh(p) for regular level sets (including rank–nullity), and works through the orthogonal group O(n): its differential, surjectivity, dimension n(n−1)/2, tangent space R·Skew(n), and the three rotational degrees of freedom of SO(3) — and why the codomain must be the symmetric matrices.

episodes.zh_summary: 一阶黎曼几何回答两个问题：往哪走、怎么走。本集用曲线定义微分并证明良定义，讲对偶空间与 Riesz 表示定理（含证明），说明梯度依赖于内积的选择；定义黎曼度量与黎曼梯度并证明最速上升性；最后定义 retraction，证明沿 −grad f 的一阶下降性质 φ′(0) = −‖grad f(x)‖²。
episodes.en_summary: First-order Riemannian geometry answers two questions: which direction, and how to move. This episode defines the differential through curves and proves it is well defined, covers the dual space and the Riesz representation theorem (with proof), shows that the gradient depends on the inner product, defines the Riemannian metric and gradient and proves steepest ascent, and finally defines retractions and proves the first-order descent property φ′(0) = −‖grad f(x)‖².
